output.summary: A deciduous shrub or small tree native to the Azores, Europe and the Middle East. It bears flat clusters of ivory flowers and drooping clusters of glossy, dark purple-to-black berries. The flowers have a long culinary tradition, while the berries are mildly poisonous raw but edible after cooking.
output.edibilityNote: Flowers are traditionally used in drinks and fritters; berries are mildly poisonous raw but edible after cooking. Seeds and green parts contain cyanogenic glycosides.
